Candidate rule proposed ## Reproduced symptom Reproduced — On dak.gg/er the PAM ad popup (whose blocked creative leaves the reporter's empty "광고 이미지" placeholder), the unfilled in-page ad slot #⁠er_top and the app-install bottom sheet were all reproduced in the AdGuard CLI baseline, and one domain-scoped cosmetic rule hiding exactly those three containers was verified (popup/slot/sheet visible in phase B, hidden in phase C, page integrity intact). Proposed for BaseFilter/sections/specific.txt. ## Rule `dak.gg##div:has(> div > #er_top),body > div[data-pam-popup],body > div:has(> div a.install-link[href*="gg.dak.bser"])` ## Policy rationale No rule of the run instruction's policy closes this report:⁠ it is not a paywall, not a German (or any) anti-adblock wall - no detector request appears in the captured network log and the page shows no wall - and not a scam, phishing or tech-support page. The 'site's own advertising (first-party ads):⁠ no rule; recommend closing' rule does not cover the reported ad containers:⁠ the popup carries a third-party advertiser creative (Monster Hunter Now) served through pam.dakgg.io / pam-assets.dak.gg and #⁠er_top is a Google ad slot left unfilled after the gpt tag is redirected, which is not self-promotion as the filter policy's Terminology defines it (goods or services owned by the site owner with no third-party compensation). The app-install bottom sheet is a self-promotion annoyance in the AdGuard Mobile App Banners category, which the repository already maintains rules for on this very site, so removing it is rule generation in the annoyance family rather than deliberate blocking of the site's own ads in the ad filters. ## Place in the list [BaseFilter/sections/specific.txt](https://github.com/AdguardTeam/AdguardFilters/blob/1b236f4815f33f6723f7b35a62e430ea41c310fc/BaseFilter/sections/specific.txt) Next to the site's existing rules, before [line 1303](https://github.com/AdguardTeam/AdguardFilters/blob/1b236f4815f33f6723f7b35a62e430ea41c310fc/BaseFilter/sections/specific.txt#L1303). ## Screenshots
